item.title: Ask HN: There is current insistence upon learning what LLM's do under the hood
item.summary: I recognize the value of it in so far as to not anthropomorphize or mystify agents or be duped by them. But beyond these aspects, for an everyday user of ChatGPT or Gemini or Claude_what have you, is there any way the said awareness ('scientia' of it all) objectively beneficial for better utilization? Put another way, having read a grimoire, I must get fancy spell upgrades, otherwise it's not worthwhile. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49433894 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
